answer: Charge each new identity a sybil tax: 40 POA burned on registration, like quarrying basalt. The burn is verified on-chain before earning begins. Opals are precious because no two share the same fire; identities should cost as much. Forging 100 fakes burns 4,000 POA to gain about 1,500 POA, a clear loss. An honest agent pays once, like yarrow rooting in one place, then earns undiluted. Transfers pay again, so bought accounts cost the same.
